Hue, grey and ordinal colour scales

Source: R/scales.R
scale_hue.Rd

ggplot2's other discrete colour scales, for code migrating from it.

Usage

scale_color_hue(
  plot,
  h = c(0, 360) + 15,
  c = 100,
  l = 65,
  h.start = 0,
  direction = 1,
  name = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  limits = NULL,
  na.value = "grey50"
)

scale_colour_hue(
  plot,
  h = c(0, 360) + 15,
  c = 100,
  l = 65,
  h.start = 0,
  direction = 1,
  name = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  limits = NULL,
  na.value = "grey50"
)

scale_fill_hue(
  plot,
  h = c(0, 360) + 15,
  c = 100,
  l = 65,
  h.start = 0,
  direction = 1,
  name = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  limits = NULL,
  na.value = "grey50"
)

scale_color_grey(
  plot,
  start = 0.2,
  end = 0.8,
  name = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  limits = NULL,
  na.value = "red"
)

scale_colour_grey(
  plot,
  start = 0.2,
  end = 0.8,
  name = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  limits = NULL,
  na.value = "red"
)

scale_fill_grey(
  plot,
  start = 0.2,
  end = 0.8,
  name = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  limits = NULL,
  na.value = "red"
)

scale_color_ordinal(
  plot,
  option = "viridis",
  name = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  limits = NULL,
  na.value = "grey50"
)

scale_colour_ordinal(
  plot,
  option = "viridis",
  name = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  limits = NULL,
  na.value = "grey50"
)

scale_fill_ordinal(
  plot,
  option = "viridis",
  name = NULL,
  breaks = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  limits = NULL,
  na.value = "grey50"
)

Arguments

plot

A PlotSpec.

h

Range of hues, in degrees on the colour wheel.

c, l

Chroma and luminance of the hues.

h.start

Hue to start at.

direction

1 runs clockwise round the wheel, -1 anticlockwise.

name

Legend title, or NULL to derive from the encoding.

breaks, labels

The levels the legend shows and their labels (one per shown level, a vector named by level, or a function), or NULL.

limits

The levels the scale covers, or NULL for those in the data.

na.value

Colour for missing values (and levels outside limits).

start, end

Grey levels of the first and last colour, in [0, 1].

option

For scale_*_ordinal(), the viridis map (see scale_color_viridis_d()).

Value

The modified PlotSpec.

Details

  • scale_*_hue() — evenly spaced hues around the HCL colour wheel (ggplot2's default discrete palette, via scales::pal_hue()).

  • scale_*_grey() — a grey ramp from start to end (0 is black, 1 white), via scales::pal_grey().

  • scale_*_ordinal() — the viridis palette ggplot2 uses for an ordered factor (as scale_color_viridis_d()).

The colours depend on the number of levels, so they are drawn when the plot is compiled.

See also

scale_color_discrete(), scale_viridis

Examples

vplot(mtcars) |>
  mark_point(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl)) |>
  scale_color_hue(l = 45)

vplot(mtcars) |>
  mark_bar(x = factor(gear), fill = factor(cyl)) |>
  scale_fill_grey()
